headline.zh-CN: 准确的待办与重开申请审批
headline.en: Accurate pending tasks and reopen approvals

summary.zh-CN: 首页待办按当前职责展示，曲目工作台入口遵循阶段权限；主催可在曲目详情直接处理重开申请。
summary.en: Dashboard tasks reflect current responsibilities, workflow entry points follow stage permissions, and album managers can handle reopen requests from track details.

heading.en: Pending tasks and workflow entry points

description.zh-CN: “等待我处理”覆盖阶段审批、评审指派、修订上传、母带交付与确认，以及已提交的补交和重开申请审批。已完成曲目的可选重开、补交入口保留在详情中，已归档内容退出待办。
description.en: Waiting for Me covers stage decisions, reviewer assignment, revision uploads, master delivery and confirmation, and submitted follow-up and reopen approvals. Optional reopen and follow-up actions remain in track details, while archived content leaves the queue.

title.zh-CN: 工作台入口遵循当前阶段权限
title.en: Match workflow entry points to stage permissions

description.zh-CN: 阶段任务进入对应工作台，申请审批进入曲目详情。曲师在接收审核阶段可继续使用源音频补交入口，工作台入口按当前用户的阶段操作权限展示。
description.en: Stage tasks open the corresponding workspace, while request approvals open track details. Composers retain source follow-up actions during intake, and workflow entry points reflect the current user's stage permissions.

title.zh-CN: 在曲目详情批准或拒绝申请
title.en: Approve or reject requests in track details

description.zh-CN: 专辑管理者可查看待审批申请的目标阶段与原因，并直接批准重开或拒绝申请。批准后进入申请的目标阶段，拒绝后保持已完成，申请状态与待办同步更新。曲师可查看待审批状态。
description.en: Album managers can review the requested stage and reason, then approve or reject the request. Approval enters the requested stage; rejection keeps the track completed. Request status and pending tasks update together, and composers can view pending status.
